title: Ampere force magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be 0.25 N (or equivalent).

title: Joule heat magnitude
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be 40.0 J (or equivalent).

title: Apply Ampere's force law
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the formula F = BIL to calculate the force on the rod.

title: Apply Joule's heating law
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the formula Q = I²Rt to calculate the thermal energy.

title: Identify relevant quantities
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify and use the given values B, I, L, R, and t in the appropriate formulas.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution may include proper unit analysis (e.g., T·A·m = N, A²·Ω·s = J).

title: Confusing force directions
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates force using velocity or resistance instead of current, or confuses force on the rod with other forces.

title: Misapplying Ohm's law
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student unnecessarily calculates or uses an induced emf (ε = BLv) when the current I is already given directly.
